messages:
Tia: Kicking off a short thread for the calibration + prompt-set we need for next week's quant bakeoff (FP8 / INT8 / GPTQ / AWQ). Need: strata, negative controls, prompt variants, and run configs. Goal: measure accuracy delta vs fp16 baseline across deployment profiles.

Aj: +1. Propose 2k samples for initial sweep so we can iterate quickly. Stratify by domain (chat, code, math, instruction) and length buckets (<=50, 51-200, >200).

Maria: Agreed. Also want ~10-15% adversarial/edge-case prompts and anchors (~5% per domain) to monitor regressions. Anchors = stable, high-quality examples we expect no-regression on.

Sam: Recommend embedding-based clustering for diversity so we avoid near-duplicates. Select cluster centroids per domain+bucket, then sample within clusters.

Tia: Negative-control checklist: hallucination probes, contradictory-fact pairs, numeric-precision (math) checks, code-safety (malicious injection). Include format-sensitive prompts (function-calling / tool output).

Maria: Metrics per model/quant: exact match, token-level F1, mean per-token logprob, KL divergence of logits vs fp16 (where feasible), embedding cosine similarity of outputs, and a binary hallucination sentinel.

Aj: For each prompt produce two template variants: direct (short) and contextual (adds 2-3 extra turns or a doc snippet). This will exercise cache/KV and context sensitivity.

Sam: Deployment profiles to mimic: hosted-lowlatency (seq cap 256, batch=1, p99 latency target), dedicated-throughput (batch=8/16, higher seq_len), private-longseq (seq_len up to 2048, streaming). Run every quant config against all three.

Tia: Example run configs to standardize: 
# hosted-lowlatency
batch_size: 1
max_tokens: 256
temp: 0.0
top_p: 0.95

# dedicated-throughput
batch_size: 8
max_tokens: 512
temp: 0.0

# private-longseq
batch_size: 4
max_tokens: 2048
temp: 0.0

Use deterministic sampling (temp=0) for primary metrics.

Maria: Sampling script prototype: 
python tools/sample_calib.py --domains chat,code,math,instruction --buckets "50,200,2048" --size 2000 --adv_ratio 0.12 --anchors_per_domain 10 --seed 42 --diversify_by embeddings
Outputs CSV with id, domain, bucket, adv_flag, anchor_flag, prompt_variant, gold_answer.

Aj: Gold labels: human-annotate anchors + adversarial subset. For larger pool use fp16 ensemble majority or high-confidence generation plus human spot-checking.

Sam: For quant diffs capture logits (sampled tokens), per-token logprobs, and perf traces. Record model variant name, quant backend, and compilation flags (e.g., awq+gptq, int8-fused).

ci-bot: scheduled ci:quant-bakeoff job for branch feat/quant-bakeoff on 2065432160. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/9832 :robot_face: 

Tia: Next steps: Maria to produce sampling script + initial 2k CSV, Aj to build prompt templates and contextual variants, Sam to set up run matrix for three deployment profiles and quant backends. Deliverables: CSV + prompt folder + run-matrix YAML by EOD Thursday. :calendar: :thumbsup: 

Maria: Noted, will push scripts + initial sample by EOD Thursday with quick sanity stats (counts, avg length, clusters).

Aj: Add a tiny set (n=50) of tokenizer edge-cases (weird unicode, long identifiers) to catch quant-specific tokenizer regressions.

Sam: I'll add perf knobs and run an fp16 baseline. Will tag results with commit, env, and compile flags.

Tia: Thanks all. Review first-run outputs in Friday morning sync. If you want to add special-case prompts, drop them in /shared/evals/calib-drafts/ before Thursday noon.
